CREATE SEQUENCE nw_input_calls; CREATE DOMAIN nw_counted AS integer CHECK (nextval('nw_input_calls') > 0)
CREATE VIEW nw_effect AS SELECT sum(v) OVER w AS total, row_number() OVER w AS ordinal FROM nw_source WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY '{1}'::nw_counted[]); SELECT last_value AS calls FROM nw_input_calls
SELECT * FROM nw_effect ORDER BY ordinal; SELECT last_value AS calls FROM nw_input_calls
CREATE VIEW nw_unused_effect AS SELECT 1 AS value WINDOW unused AS (ORDER BY '{2}'::nw_counted[]); SELECT last_value AS calls FROM nw_input_calls
SELECT * FROM nw_unused_effect; SELECT last_value AS calls FROM nw_input_calls
